calendarFaqs.q: When does Arlington Public Schools start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: APS K–12 students start Monday, August 31, 2026. PreK and VPI students start Tuesday, September 1.

calendarFaqs.q: When is APS Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: APS Spring Break runs Monday, March 22, through Friday, March 26, 2027. Students return Monday, March 29.

calendarFaqs.q: Do all APS early-release days apply to every grade level?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Some APS early releases apply only to elementary students, some only to high school students, and others to elementary, middle, and high school students. The full calendar keeps those grade-level labels.

calendarFaqs.q: How does APS handle snow days and emergency closures?
calendarFaqs.a: APS says approximately the first 10 days lost to weather or other emergencies do not need to be made up because the calendar includes instructional time above Virginia's 990-hour minimum. APS also tracks time lost to delayed openings, early closings, and full-day closures. If additional make-up time is needed, the superintendent may submit a plan to the School Board.

whatsNew.title: What Changed from 2025–26
content: School starts later this year. APS opens on August 31, six days later than the August 25 start in 2025–26.
The last day moves up by one day. School ends June 17, compared with June 18 last year.
Spring Break comes earlier. The 2026–27 break runs March 22–26; last year's break ran March 30–April 3.
